class.name: AnimationSystem
class.brief_description: Parallelized animation engine for high-frequency property and skeletal updates.
class.description: [AnimationSystem] handles the time-based progression of entity states. It is designed to decouple animation logic from the frame rate, providing smooth interpolation and state blending for massive entity counts. The system operates on the [b]multi-threaded simulation pass[/b], allowing it to process thousands of skeletal bone transforms in parallel. It supports two primary modes: - [b]Property Animation:[/b] Driving component values (like opacity, scale, or custom shader params) over time. - [b]Skeletal Animation:[/b] Updating bone hierarchies for characters. Bone data is stored in the [BoneBufferComponent] and pushed directly to the [RenderingServer] or [Skeleton3D] nodes. [b]Performance Note:[/b] This system uses a "baked" animation approach where keyframes are pre-processed into SIMD-friendly buffers, minimizing the lookup overhead during execution.

method.name: process_animation_updates
method.description: Advances the animation clocks for all entities with an [AnimationComponent]. It performs linear or cubic interpolation based on the current state and updates the target component values in the registry.

method.name: process_skeletal_updates
method.description: Specifically handles the bone-transform skinning logic. It reads the local bone matrices, applies the global entity transform, and prepares the final world-space matrices for the renderer.
